name: Pentecost
overview: Pentecost, also known as the Feast of Weeks or the Feast of Harvest, is a biblically instituted celebration occurring fifty days after the Sabbath following the wave offering, marking the day of firstfruits. Scripture details the offerings made during this feast, including two wave loaves baked with leaven and seven lambs, symbolizing a sweet savor offering to the Lord. This day not only commemorates the harvest but is also significant as the moment the Holy Spirit was given to the apostles, emphasizing its fulfillment and centrality in God’s redemptive plan.
